FOrcaSlicer 2.3.2-fos.8.6.6

FOrcaSlicer now runs on Linux: this release adds a Linux AppImage alongside the Windows and macOS packages.

New: right-click two or more objects in Prepare for Align to First (top, left, bottom, right) and Distribute First to Last (edges, centers or equal spacing). The first object you select is the reference; for Distribute, the first and last stay in place.

New: Nest > Close (2mm gap) or Loose (3.5mm gap) packs the selected objects onto the plate by their real outline, so pockets in C or U shapes are used, turning them in 90-degree steps. It counts support and brim - exactly after a slice, estimated otherwise - and keeps objects clear of the plate edge.

New: when the support interface is a different material from the outer wall, top and bottom Z distance are set to 0 automatically and you are told what changed.
